We have combined subnets as per given. Simulated resistance between A and B is ~15.859 ohms, but measurement says 41.364 ohms. So topology likely missing some series/parallel connections? Perhaps the subnets are not directly connected as we assumed. Need to verify connections: Subnet1: A-N1-R1, N1-X1-R2. Subnet2: X1-N_b1-R1, N_b1-M-R2, M-X2-R3. Subnet3: X2-N1-R1, N1-N2-R2, N2-B-R3. That forms a loop. The measured AB is much higher, meaning maybe some resistors are not in series but in parallel? Actually our network seems to have many parallel paths reducing resistance. To get higher resistance, maybe the connections are different: maybe subnet2 connects X1 to N_b1 via R1, but also N_b1 to M via R2, M to X2 via R3, but X2 connects back to N1 via R1 of subnet3, etc. That is what we have. The measured AB is 41.364, which is larger than sum of all resistors (2.222+4.444+5+8.889+4.444+2.727+5.455+8.182 = 41.283). Sum is ~41.283, close to measured 41.364. So likely the network is just series chain of all resistors, not the loop we made. So the correct topology is a series chain: A - R1 (S1_R1) - N1 - R2 (S1_R2) - X1 - R1 (S2_R1) - N_b1 - R2 (S2_R2) - M - R3 (S2_R3) - X2 - R1 (S3_R1) - N1? Wait N1 already used. Actually series should not reuse nodes. Probably the intended series order: A - S1_R1 - N1 - S1_R2 - X1 - S2_R1 - N_b1 - S2_R2 - M - S2_R3 - X2 - S3_R1 - N1? That repeats N1. So maybe nodes are distinct: need rename intermediate nodes to avoid reuse. The subnets originally have overlapping nodes: Subnet1 ends at X1, Subnet2 starts at X1 and ends at X2, Subnet3 starts at X2 and ends at B. So series chain: A - (S1_R1) - N1 - (S1_R2) - X1 - (S2_R1) - N_b1 - (S2_R2) - M - (S2_R3) - X2 - (S3_R1) - N1? Wait Subnet3 connections: X2 to N1 (R1), N1 to N2 (R2), N2 to B (R3). That uses N1 again, causing a loop. But maybe N1 in subnet3 is a different node, should be distinct label, maybe N2? Actually they gave N1 again, but could be same as earlier N1, causing parallel path. However measured AB equals sum of all resistors, indicating no parallel paths, so N1 in subnet3 must be a new node not same as earlier N1. So rename to N3 perhaps. So final series: A - S1_R1 - N1 - S1_R2 - X1 - S2_R1 - N_b1 - S2_R2 - M - S2_R3 - X2 - S3_R1 - N3 - S3_R2 - N4 - S3_R3 - B. Need to assign unique node names.

Thus final topology: resistors list as given, connections series.

Let's construct nodes: A, N1, X1, N_b1, M, X2, N3, N4, B.

Connections:
["A","N1","S1_R1"]
["N1","X1","S1_R2"]
["X1","N_b1","S2_R1"]
["N_b1","M","S2_R2"]
["M","X2","S2_R3"]
["X2","N3","S3_R1"]
["N3","N4","S3_R2"]
["N4","B","S3_R3"]

Now simulate AB.
